title: SPA/167/2024 of MAYANK VASHISTHA Vs STATE OF UTTARAKHAND

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
HON'BLE THE CHIEF JUSTICE MS RITU BAHRI
AND
HON'BLE JUSTICE SHRI ALOK KUMAR VERMA
07th
, AUGUST 2024
SPECIAL APPEAL NO.167 OF 2024
Mayank Vashistha ...... Appellant
Vs.
State of Uttarakhand and Another ......Respondents
Counsel for the Appellant : Mr. Ketan Joshi,
 Advocate.
Counsel for the State/ : Mr. K.N. Joshi, Deputy
Respondent no.1. Advocate General
 assisted by Ms. Rajni
Supyal, Brief Holder.
Counsel for the Respondent : Ms. Priyanka Agarwal,
No. 2. Advocate.
Judgment: (per Ms. Ritu Bahri, C.J.)
The appellant has come up in Appeal against
the judgment and order dated 29.04.2024, passed by the
learned Single Judge in Writ Petition (S/S) No.676 of 2024,
"Mayank Vashistha vs. State of Uttarakhand and Others",
whereby, the learned Single Judge has dismissed the Writ
Petition in limine.
2. In the present case, the date of birth of the
appellant is 04.07.1981 and taking his age on 01.01.2024,
he has completed almost 43 years.

2
3. The learned counsel for the appellant further
argued that the advertisement was issued on 14.03.2024
and the recruitment year starts from 01.07.2023. Even this
argument is liable to be rejected, keeping in view Sub-clause (V) Rule 3 of the Uttarakhand Sub-Ordinate
Education (Trained Graduate Category) Service Rules,
2014, (in short, the Rules, 2014) (Annexure No.2, page 46
dated 19.02.2014), it is mentioned that:-
"HkrhZ dk o'kZ ls d SysaMj o'kZ ds t qykbZ ds izFke fnol ls vkjEHk gksu s okyh
ckjg ekl dh vof/k vfHkiszr gSA"
It means, in the present case, the
advertisement was issued on 14.03.2024 and the
recruitment process starts from 01.07.2024 till 01.07.2025.
This is the interpretation given as per the Rules, 2014, the
recruitment year starts from 01.07.2024 and ends
01.07.2025.
4. Since there is no challenge of the Rules, 2014,
no case is made to give benefit to the appellant - writ
petitioner to allow him to participate in the selection
process, as he has crossed the maximum age of 43 years
on 01.07.2024.
5. The argument of the learned counsel for the
appellant is that in the previous recruitment process, they
have taken the date a year prior to the date of the
advertisement cannot be made as a ground to give benefit

3
to the appellant against the Rules, 2014 (Annexure No.2
page 46 dated 19.02.2014) in the present case.
6. In view of the above, the Special Appeal (SPA
No.167 of 2024) is dismissed accordingly.

 RITU BAHRI, C.J.

ALOK KUMAR VERMA, J.
